microTransitions.note: No bounce, no elastic, anywhere in the system.

narrative.northStar: El Cuaderno de Bitácora del Taller — the digital logbook of a tire workshop: a field tool read under direct sun, not a consumer app.
narrative.overview: A dark, monospaced instrument-panel UI for capturing tire measurements in the field. Data is the content; nothing decorative competes with it.
keyCharacteristics: Dark console dedicated to field data capture (screen-dark + field-dark)
Monospace typography everywhere except the wordmark
2px borders as the only state language — no shadow for focus/hover
Orange = action/focus/alert; yellow = milestone/highlight; green = 'complete' only
Zero decoration — every visible element serves capture or reading of a data point
narrative.elevationConfirmed: Tonal layering (screen-dark → field-dark → navy-brand) is the elevation model. Shadow verified present in only two places codebase-wide (both floating overlays: autocomplete dropdown, search suggestions) — confirms shadow-only-for-overlays as an observed rule, not an assumption.
narrative.componentCharacter: Directo y sin adornos, sólido y con peso — 2px borders, no gradients, no decoration, but font weights 700-900 and thick borders give it deliberate industrial heft rather than minimalist lightness.
rules: La Regla del Naranja Único — only one focus/action element per screen at a time
La Regla del Verde Exclusivo — green means 'position complete' and nothing else
La Regla del Mono Total — no humanist/serif font introduced anywhere
La Regla de la Sombra Reservada — shadow only on elements floating above screen content
dos: 2px border state language, never shadow for focus
short easing (0.15-0.28s ease-out / expo, no bounce/elastic)
donts: no gradient cards / generic SaaS admin-panel look (anti-reference)
no box-shadow on cards/buttons/inputs in normal flow
no opacity for disabled state — always explicit recolor
narrative.uncertainty: North Star, elevation confirmation, and component character were proposed as recommended defaults after an AskUserQuestion round went unanswered (60s timeout). All three are strongly evidenced by direct code extraction (see elevationConfirmed above) but were not explicitly confirmed by the user — revisit if corrected.
